rationale: Re-issue annotations (reissuedFrom, reissueNote) describe a stamp issued against an older corpus hash; a freshly issued stamp for a new corpus hash supersedes them.
mixedEffects.error recorded a failed fit (singular matrix); when the refit succeeds the block carries coefficients and no error.

ThermalFuelPenalty attenuationDistance is recomputed per cohort and is null when the fit does not return an estimate on the live corpus (the dashboard renders it only when attenuationKm != null); its children cannot exist then.

The ingestion refresh (M377b) has no R point and no pre-registered expected file; source.R referenced the former-raw (R) point file of the M375 raw-swap provenance study, which stays in analyses/ (M375 record) and in carriedBasis. Applies only to an entry whose rerunMilestone changed.

The ingestion refresh (M377b) has no R point and no pre-registered expected file; source.expected referenced the pre-registered expected-delta file of the M375 definition change, which stays in analyses/ (M375 record) and in carriedBasis. Applies only to an entry whose rerunMilestone changed.
